auth.signInLead: Sign in make you continue from where you stop.
auth.signUpLead: E free, and e go ready before one minute finish.
auth.name: Wetin Oya go dey call you?
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 letters or numbers. Short sentence dey work well.
auth.terms: I gree with Oya terms and privacy notice (draft until launch).
auth.forgotPassword: You forget your password? Password reset dey come soon. For now, message Oya team.
auth.under18Title: Oya never dey for people wey never reach 18
auth.under18Body: We no fit open account for you yet, and we no keep anything wey you type. If you need help now now, these numbers dey work for everybody.

app.lead: Na here your requests go dey. To ask Oya go land for the next update.
app.emptyBody: When you ask Oya for something, e go show here with every step.

settings.title: Settings
settings.passwordChanged: Password don change. We don sign you out for every other place.
settings.signOutOthers: Sign out for every other place
settings.signedOutOthers: We don sign you out for {count, plural, one {# other device} other {# other devices}}.
settings.noOtherSessions: Na only here you sign in.
settings.twoFactorOn: E dey on. You go enter code from your authenticator app when you open the ops console.
settings.twoFactorStaffOnly: Oya staff accounts must use two-step sign in.

ops.title: Ops console
ops.lead: The queue, task inspector and provider tools go come for later milestones.
ops.verifyLead: Enter the 6-digit code wey your authenticator app show.
ops.enrolLead: Ops accounts need second step for sign in. Scan this code with authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password), then enter the 6-digit code wey e show.
ops.enrolManual: You no fit scan am? Type this key for the app instead:
ops.queueLead: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing dey open.} one {# item dey open, the urgent ones first.} other {# items dey open, the urgent ones first.}}
ops.selfHarmItem: Safety event (self-harm support show). Na only admin fit see the text.

emergency.title: Emergency help
emergency.lead: If person dey for danger or e wound well well, call now now. No wait for Oya to answer.
emergency.call112Detail: E free for all network for Naija. Police, fire and ambulance.
emergency.notADoctor: Oya no fit give medical advice or tell you how serious the thing be. Emergency people fit.
emergency.selfHarm: If you dey think to end your life or to harm yourself, call 112 now, or go the emergency side for the nearest hospital. You no dey alone for this matter.
emergency.localNumbersPending: Ambulance numbers for Akwa Ibom go show for here once our team don call each one confirm say e dey work.
emergency.worksOffline: This page go work without data if you don open am before.

offline.title: Network no dey
offline.message: Your message no go send. We don keep wetin you type.

chat.emptyLead: Talk wetin you need. Oya go sort am.
chat.failed: E no go. Abeg try again. For emergency, call 112.
chat.offline: Network no dey. Your message no go send. We keep wetin you type.
chat.offlineBanner: Network no dey. Emergency numbers still dey work.
chat.supportLinesPending: Our team dey check the support line numbers. If you dey for danger, call 112.
chat.staleGuide: We need check this guide again. Confirm the fee for the official site.
chat.composerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for new line

power.fewReporters: Neighbours never dey report well for here. Tap ON or OFF when light change, e go help everybody.

alerts.none: No alert don post for your area today.

inbox.label: Notifications
inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.empty: Reminders and alerts go show here.
inbox.pushOn: Notifications don on for this phone.
inbox.pushBlocked: Your browser don block notifications for this site.

settingsPower.title: Light & alerts
settingsPower.noClusters: We never map light areas for your side yet.
settingsPower.usage: How you dey use light everyday (for units estimate)
settingsPower.overnightHint: Light alerts from 10pm to 6am, like to pump water.
settingsPower.digestHint: For 7am, only when alert dey for your area. Push or inside app only.
settingsPower.pushOff: E no dey on. Reminders still dey show for the bell.
settingsPower.pushUnsupported: This browser no fit receive notifications. Dem still dey show for the bell.

opsAlerts.title: Local alerts
opsAlerts.lead: Only from verified source: DisCo notice, government and FRSC road block, flood, official advisory. No social media.
opsAlerts.sourceHint: You must add am. The page wey you check.
opsAlerts.noAreas: We never import areas. Run scripts/import-areas.ts first.
